en.guideSubtitle: Basic principles of immediate evacuation to save lives
en.guideRule1Desc: If you feel a strong shake or hear a tsunami warning, start evacuating immediately without waiting for more information.
en.guideRule2Desc: To escape a tsunami, aim for high ground, not just inland. Target the 3rd floor or higher of a sturdy concrete building.
en.guideRule3Desc: Once evacuated, never return to retrieve belongings or check the shore. Stay safe until all warnings are fully cleared.
en.guideRule4Desc: Do not search for or wait for family and friends — each person decides for themselves and evacuates immediately by whatever route they understand. Trusting that everyone else is doing the same ultimately saves the most lives. This is “tsunami tendenko,” a teaching handed down in Japan's Sanriku region, and it is also where this app's name, TENDEN, comes from. The two routes this app offers exist so each person can judge their own situation and start moving right away — not so everyone takes the same path.
